create_agent: create an Agent instance with a model, MCP servers, and optional provider configuration
run_agent: run the Agent with a user input string and optional asyncio abort event
load_tools: load MCP tools from configured servers into the Agent for tool-use inference
test_agent_run: test the Agent run method with user input and verify streaming output chunks
review_agent_class: review the Agent class and its initialization with model, servers, and prompt parameters
